summary: This PR fixes TypeScript type defaults for `Factory`/`createFactory` (changing default generics from `any` to `Env`/`string`) and adds an explicit return type to `createMiddleware`, purely to correct type inference (issue #3847) so that middleware created via `factory.createMiddleware()` has a properly typed schema instead of `any`. No runtime logic changes; a new type-level test (`Expect<Equal<...>>`) was added to verify the fix.
